take: Minnesota announced a five-part move: F Rieger Lorenz and D Matt Kiersted were recalled from Iowa (AHL), F Tyler Pitlick was assigned there, F Nick Foligno went on injured reserve, and G Filip Gustavsson went on long-term injured reserve. Foligno's fourth-line minutes (9:57 a night) have already shifted over five games without him: Yakov Trenin took his spot beside McCarron, and Blake Coleman rose to 16:34 a night from 15:01. Minnesota is 6-2-1, and Kiersted has the strongest early numbers of the call-ups, though over only two games.
